subject: Stagegate plan for data residency and staged APAC rollout (renewal)
messages:
From: Susan Liu <susan.liu@medicloud.health>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-20T09:17:00Z
Subject: Renewal + EU residency requirements / APAC staging

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profiles and the KV cache behavior. We're starting our renewal discussion internally and there are two items that will be gating acceptance:

1) EU data residency for production traffic (required by our legal team)
2) A staged APAC rollout (we want a pilot in SG, then AUS) with cross-region failover to EU for DR

Can you share a proposed timeline and any SOW language that covers: residency assurances, failover behavior (RTO/RPO targets), and pricing impact for reserved capacity during the pilot and ramp?

Also include any necessary SOC2 evidence or docs we can push to our compliance team.

Attaching a high-level matrix of our expected traffic by region.

Best,
Susan
---
MediCloud Health — Sr. Procurement Manager
(attachment: traffic_matrix_q4.xlsx)

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Susan Liu <susan.liu@medicloud.health>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-23T14:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency requirements / APAC staging

Hi Susan — thanks for the clear ask and the matrix. We're aligned that residency and a low-risk APAC pilot during renewal is the right approach.

High level proposal (summary):
- EU residency: provision a dedicated EU tenant (data at rest and primary inference served from eu-west-1) as part of the renewed contract; our standard residency SLA and audit logs included.
- APAC staged rollout: pilot in Singapore (SG) for 6 weeks, followed by optional AUS staging. During pilot we recommend a smaller dedicated pool (burstable) and an autoscale policy tuned to the pilot profile.
- Cross-region failover: synchronous failover policy for control-plane; read-only KV cache failover for stateful workflows. RTO target: 5 minutes (control-plane failover), RPO: best-effort for cache (we'll include warmup guidance).

I've attached a draft SOW and a residency matrix. We'll need to coordinate procurement around committed burst slots for the pilot.

Next steps: can we schedule 30 minutes this week with your legal and platform leads to review SOW language? If yes, I'll loop in Ben for pricing and Marissa for rollout ops.

Thanks,
Olga
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachments: SOW_v2.pdf, residency_matrix.xlsx)

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-25T11:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal + EU residency requirements / APAC staging

Folks — adding my notes on pricing and capacity shape.

Ben's pricing proposal (pilot + renewal upsell):
- Pilot (6 weeks SG): 4 x gpus (burstable pool) reserved, billed as a pilot-credit line at 60% of standard reserved rate.
- Post-pilot ramp: option to convert reserved pilot slots into a monthly committed pool at a pro-rated annual rate.
- Dedication and residency uplift: EU dedicated tenant + audit logs = +8% recurring uplift.
- Cross-region failover (warm standby): minimal extra reserved capacity (1-2 GPUs) in EU to accept failover traffic, additional replication/control-plane overhead priced as a one-time cutover fee.

Operational notes (Marissa): we'll supply a stagegate checklist: pilot readiness, SOC2 evidence, DR runbook, cutover playbook, and a rollback window. Vivek — can you confirm the RTO/RPO feasibility for the KV cache warmup step and provide a runbook estimate (hrs)?

Ben
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: RE: Renewal + EU residency requirements / APAC staging

Hi Susan — quick follow-up with a concrete package and next steps.

Please find attached: SOW_v2.pdf (includes residency language and stagegate milestones), residency_matrix.xlsx, stagegate_timeline.png. Key points below:

- EU Residency: We'll provision an EU-dedicated tenant at contract effective date. Data-at-rest and primary inference handling will be in eu-west-1; audit logs and KMS integrations included.
- Pilot: 6-week SG pilot on a 4-GPU burstable reserved pool. Pilot pricing offered at 60% of the committed rate. Pilot success criteria: latency < 120ms p50 for targeted endpoints and successful DR failover rehearsal at week 4.
- Post-pilot: Option to convert pilot capacity into a 12-month committed pool (prorated).
- Failover: Control-plane failover RTO target 5 minutes; KV cache best-effort with documented warmup (we recommend pre-warming in the first 48 hours after failover). We'll supply DR runbook and a dry-run playbook for week 4.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm availability for a 30-minute call on Thursday 2026-12-02 (your local time) with Legal + Platform? We will bring a redline-capable SOW and the pricing sheet.
2) If agreeable, we'll send a DocuSign with the SOW and a pilot addendum for signature.

Thanks — happy to jump on the call and walk through the stagegate checklist.

Best regards,
Olga Petrov
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
(attachments: SOW_v2.pdf, residency_matrix.xlsx, stagegate_timeline.png)
